review: Re-reviewed under the side/back hanging-hand criterion: at target scale at least three rounded digit tips are visible, so the fourth-finger overlap itself is acceptable. Still reject: the isolated hand is too open/palm-forward and adult-long in its palm/wrist, with soft realistic shading unlike the fine Chibi source; it has no registered cuff/hidden-wrist integration.
probe_method: Take median RGB of the four image corners as opaque background; threshold maximum per-channel difference >18 to locate hand; crop subject; LANCZOS contain-fit to 45x48 (trial33) or 45x46 (trial34); center on original opaque background; nearest-neighbor 8x display. Diagnostic segmentation only.
initial_review: Long, narrow, adult-like palm/wrist; finger notches collapse into paw/glove at target scale. Rejected.

post_rubric_review.criterion: side/back relaxed hanging hand: at least three clearly separated rounded fingertip lobes; fourth finger may naturally overlap
